                    ## Add Performance Monitoring Endpoints

### Objective
To introduce new API endpoints for performance monitoring, enabling administrators to initiate and terminate Py-spy recordings, generating SVG files for visualization.

### Requirements
- Create a new module `codx.junior.monitoring`.
- Implement a class within `codx.junior.monitoring` to manage monitoring.
- Add an endpoint `/performance/start-monitoring` (admin only) to:
    - Start Py-spy monitoring on the current PID.
    - Save the recording as an SVG file in `images/monitoring` with a timestamped name.
- Add an endpoint `/performance/end-monitoring` (admin only) to stop the monitoring.
- Ensure the `images/monitoring` directory exists.
- Integrate these endpoints into the FastAPI application.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A new module `codx.junior.monitoring` is created.
- [x] A class `PerformanceMonitor` is implemented within `codx.junior.monitoring`.

- [x] The `/performance/end-monitoring` endpoint is functional and accessible to admin users.
- [x] Py-spy recordings can be successfully started and stopped.
- [x] SVG files are generated in the `images/monitoring` directory with correct naming conventions.
- [x] Access control for admin users is enforced on both new endpoints.

### Additional Notes
- Requires `py-spy` to be installed.
- `CODX_JUNIOR_STATIC_FOLDER` environment variable must be set for the image directory path.
- Implement error handling for Py-spy availability and file creation issues.
- The current PID can be obtained using `os.getpid()`.

## Implement `/performance/end-monitoring` Endpoint

**Objective**
To implement a new API endpoint `/performance/end-monitoring` that allows administrators to gracefully stop an active Py-spy performance recording, ensuring proper cleanup and providing feedback.

### Requirements
- Create an endpoint `/performance/end-monitoring` within the FastAPI application.
- This endpoint must be restricted to users with administrator privileges.
- Upon receiving a request to this endpoint:
    - Terminate the currently running Py-spy recording process.
    - Clean up any temporary files or resources associated with the monitoring.
    - Return a success response to the client indicating that monitoring has been stopped.
- Integrate this endpoint with the `PerformanceMonitor` class.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The `/performance/end-monitoring` endpoint is successfully added to the FastAPI application.
- [ ] Access to `/performance/end-monitoring` is restricted to administrator users.
- [ ] Calling `/performance/end-monitoring` stops an active Py-spy recording.
- [ ] The system cleans up resources associated with the monitoring session.
- [ ] A clear success response is returned to the client upon successful termination of monitoring.

### Additional Notes
- This task is a continuation of the "Add Performance Monitoring Endpoints" task, specifically focusing on the stopping mechanism.
- The endpoint should handle cases where no monitoring is currently active.
- Ensure that the stopping mechanism is robust and does not leave Py-spy processes running in the background.
- Coordinate with the implementation of the `/performance/start-monitoring` endpoint to ensure proper state management.
